notes.title: 【通神榜】X【贪婪大地】捆绑包来啦！
notes.notes:
Do you like Wuxia or Sci-fi?
Or do you want all of them?
Then here's your chance!
The launch of the [Noobs want to live] X [Greed land] bundle is now available! Two very positive VS like games join hands to bring a special offer! 
The bundle covers both sci-fi and Wuxia themes, encompassing both realistic and cute styles. You can choose to pour fire on alien swarms in the outer world, or get close to a cat demon in a secretive and mysterious peach forest! It's time for those interested to take the plunge!

notes.title: The Steam Game Awards is coming! Would you guys vote for us?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The Steam Game Awards is coming!
If <Noobs wants to live> has brought joy and relaxation to everyone in the upcoming year, that would make our greatest honor!
Now that the Steam Game Awards selection has begun, we invite you to vote for <Noobs wants to live>, even if the hopes are slim! Please kindly find the Steam Awards voting section on the Steam homepage and search and <Noobs wants to live> in the "Sit back and relax" category! Thank you for your continued support, and we'll continue to make fun games for everyone! 
<Noobs wants to live> is also on sale for a limited time at 23% off, so feel free to try it out if you haven't yet!

notes.title: [Noobs Want to Live] is now available with a first-week discount of $4.24
notes.notes:
Noobs Want to Live, the brand new fast-paced roguelike game is now available!!!!
Official Price: $4.99
First-week discount: -15% 
Playing as a mortal in Peachville, you need to defeat the adorable but dangerous mythical creatures. Fight, kill and grow more and more powerful until you become a god-like being!!!!
We will then focus on optimizing game performance and fixing bugs. Feel free to leave feedback on our Discord server and Steam Discussions!
(About 5-10% of the text has not yet been translated into English, we will complete the translation work as soon as possible)
The attached picture shows our dev plan for next month. We will keep going and please look forward to the new features!!! Thank you for your love and support!!!

notes.title: [Noobs Want to Live] Will be available at 20:00 pm PST on Feb 13th!!!
notes.notes:
Noobs Want to Live, the brand new fast-paced roguelike game will officially launch at 20:00 pm PST on Feb 13th, with a discount price of $4.24 (-15%) for the first week of purchase!!!!
Playing as a mortal in Peachville, you need to defeat the adorable but dangerous mythical creatures , train yourself and become more and more powerful until you become a powerful god-like being!!!!
(English translation will be available after launch)

notes.title: Release Day is set! See u on February 14!
notes.notes:
Noobs Want to Live is an action rogue-lite and bullet hell  game. These noobs coincidentally gather in the silent but perilous peach blossoms. Making a unique build  with a range of characters and a huge number of skills to get new experiences and survive the attack.

Wish you good luck in the peach blossoms and thank you for the support and encouragement throughout these days!
